conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Biomass offers energy independence and waste reduction, but it can have higher emissions and land use demands compared to solar or wind.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Biomass combustion can release greenhouse gases and particulate matter, similar to fossil fuels, depending on the feedstock and technology used. Sustainable forest management and advanced conversion technologies can mitigate these emissions.
